answers: Right on the main screen under 'NJ Driver's Test', it says 'Real test: 50 questions, 40 correct to pass (80%)'. So I need to answer 50 questions and get at least 40 of them right.

I would tap the big 'Weak Spots' button that says 'Most missed' under it on the home screen. I did notice a 'Signs And Signals' bar under the 'CATEGORIES' section when I opened 'About this test', but it's just text and a bar—there's no actual button visible to let me practice *only* that specific category.

When I tapped the wrong answer, the box for the answer I picked (A) turned red with an 'x' icon, and the correct one (B) turned green with a checkmark. The score at the top right also updated to '0 / 1' with the 1 in red. It also showed a blue box explaining the rule and a grey box quoting the manual.

When I expand the 'About this test' dropdown, it says 'Source: 2025 New Jersey Driver Manual (www.njmvc.gov)'. Since I'm pretty good with tech, I'd just open my browser and go to www.njmvc.gov to find that 2025 manual and verify it myself.

Right under the big 'NJ Driver's Test' title, there's a blue 'New Jersey' text with a little down arrow (v) next to it. Tapping that dropdown would probably take me back to the first screen where I can use the 'Search states...' bar to find Pennsylvania.

There's some tiny grey text right below those language bubbles that explains it: '✓ = offered on the official MVC test — other languages are practice-only'. So the check mark means the real NJ DMV actually lets you take the test in that language.

The main thing that felt missing is a way to study specific topics. It shows me 'CATEGORIES' like 'Signs And Signals' with 43 questions, but I can't tap them. Also, on the quiz screen, I see a 'Next' button and a '<- Exit' button, but there is absolutely no 'Back' button visible if I wanted to look at a previous question again.
